about: St Ives Surf School runs surf lessons from its HQ on Porthmeor Beach in St Ives, Cornwall, and runs paddleboarding and kayaking from a watersports centre on Porthminster Beach. It is a Surfing England Centre of Excellence and works with The Wave Project surf therapy charity.
offers: Surf lessons at five levels, beginner to advanced
Hire: surfboards, wetsuits and bodyboards (Porthmeor); paddleboards and kayaks (Porthminster)
where: Surf HQ on Porthmeor Beach, St Ives TR26 1JZ; SUP and kayak from Porthminster Beach
goodToKnow: Long-standing partner of The Wave Project
Book online, by phone or by email
gaps: Homepage only; no lesson formats, ages, inclusions or season; footer is dated 2020.
